scheme_name: Financial assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students who have Passed First Division from Board and University
other_conditions: The applicant must be a student.
Must have passed the 12th standard examination with at least 60% marks (first division).
Must have secured at least 48% marks in the first‑year examination to be eligible for the incentive in the second year.
Must have secured at least 48% marks in the second‑year examination to be eligible for the incentive in the third year.
No gap in studies after passing the board examination.
Must be enrolled as a regular student in general education in a government college.
Students residing in government hostels are not eligible.
Applicant’s parents/guardian/husband should not be income‑tax payers.
Must possess a Jan Aadhaar Card and an Aadhaar Card.
benefits_summary: A one‑time financial incentive of up to ₹3,500, paid as ₹350 per month for a maximum of ten months through Direct Benefit Transfer to the student’s bank account.
